files.04_Other_named.json: Other identifiable named/unique characters not in groups 1-3
files.05_Generic_NPC.json: Unnamed / role-only NPCs, guards, soldiers, peasants, merchants, etc.
files.06_Coen.json: Coen sections, all coen_comments sections, and user-specified Coen sections
files.07_Character_dossiers.json: Information about significant characters from others' dialogue
files.09_Unclassified.json: Sections that remain unresolved. Check here when a section or GUID is not otherwise classified.

rules.mixed_sections: Full section duplicated under every relevant named/generic character. Coen is excluded from 06_Coen when mixed.
rules.unresolved: Raw GUIDs and their sections are preserved in 09_Unclassified when no confident assignment exists.
rules.coen_comments: Every section whose name contains coen_comments is placed in 06_Coen.
rules.single_speaker: Single-speaker sections contain only an array of plain dialogue lines.
rules.vt: All vt_e / vt_c sets appear only under the corresponding character vt; vt_e_/vt_c_ dialogue sections are removed as duplicates.

notes: Character files preserve full mixed-speaker sections; those sections are duplicated under every relevant character.
Single-speaker sections contain only an array of dialogue lines.
VT voice sets (vt_e/vt_c) appear only under each character vt and are not repeated as dialogue sections.
All coen_comments sections are assigned to Coen.
User-specified pixie sections are placed under Third Order -> Pixies.
User-specified CD_BOI_Tower_Ambrus, CD_Bakir_Tower, Coen_checkpoint_Firstreaction, and CD_Xanthe_Tower are placed in 06_Coen.
q302_40_Brencis_BeforeFight was removed from Esme and Volk and duplicated in full under Brencis and Coen; unresolved GUID keys are preserved.
